Type: oval cutout wall mirror
Use: decorating a wall, small accent; entryway, bedroom, living room
Style: modern, glam, minimalist
Materials: thin gold metal frame, mirror glass
Colors: gold, silver mirror

Feel: playful, sleek, airy
Goes with: white or blush walls, brass accents, marble; modern or glam rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand - Rivet Modern Cutout Hanging Mirror, 23"H, Gold
product.description: This stunning oval cutout mirror with its modern take on simplicity and grace is a beautiful addition to any home. Spruce up your living space with some functional modern art and enjoy the results. 23"H x 10"W x 1.25"D Mirrored glass with a gold finished metal frame Can be used as a standard mirror or an accent piece This elegant work of modern craftsmanship is 100% handmade and hand painted. Avoid moisture and wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Hardware not included.
